column1: # Nvidia's share of AI chips in China: the data behind idea 14 (read by build.py). Tab-separated.
#   period   before = "before US export curbs tightened" (Reuters's own description: NOT the same series as the two below)
#            y2025  = the year 2025; h2026 = January to June 2026 (both: counts by the research firm IDC, as reported by Reuters)
#   who      a short key; label = the name as shown; dir = toward (Nvidia, blue) | away (Chinese makers, orange) | other (grey)
#   share    per cent, as the source gives it; qkey = the line of quotes.tsv whose words hold "<share>%" for this maker
# What is left of 100 in a period is worked out by build.py and shown as "not broken down in the report" (our subtraction).
# The 2026 page does not mention AMD: no AMD row for h2026 (build.py checks the page for the name, with a control).
